variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.sub: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse.
variants.body:
The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. The collapse is a result for the labour action, not an established agreement about the underlying dispute. Readers judging {target} should avoid treating it as proof of a particular settlement, a change in wages or a complete account of responsibility.

A political movement should not confuse a failed action with a refutation of every principle associated with it. The proper argument concerns responsibility and purpose. Our convictions require attention to what a labour dispute means, rather than the convenience of treating its outcome as a complete moral judgment.

The role of {target} merits examination without treating collapse as a full explanation. This paper records the outcome of the action while leaving unreported causes and terms outside the factual account. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.sub: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse.
variants.body:
